user_goal: Preserve truthful legacy owner records that stored creation time only to whole seconds, then publish and attest the corrected patch.

baseline.protection_evidence: origin/main and immutable v0.1.10 release resolve to the reviewed commit
baseline.selection_reason: The v0.1.10 live install proved that legacy records truncate subsecond precision while CIM retains it.

semantic_changes: Compare legacy locale-formatted creation times at their stored whole-second precision.
Compare new invariant ISO owner records at full precision.
Preserve every other ownership field exactly and publish v0.1.11.
No HTML or argv ownership inference, unrelated behavior, foreign listener takeover, secret exposure, tag rewrite, or unreviewed release.

invariants: Legacy records may lose only subsecond precision; new invariant records retain exact ticks.
PID, port, root, connector, executable, command hash, and creation identity remain required.
Malformed, stale, PID-reused, exact-ISO-mismatched, and foreign records fail closed.
PR, CodeRabbit, CI, signed receipts, public main, tag, installed package, and live service bind one exact candidate.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: A live process with fractional ticks matches its truthful legacy whole-second record but exact invariant records require exact ticks.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Legacy false rejection or weakened invariant comparison.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Foreign and malformed records remain rejected without stopping the listener.
PR 5 review and exact-head CI are green.
Signed chain, verifier, and guard approve exact v0.1.11.
The untouched legacy listener upgrades safely to exact healthy v0.1.11 with clean Git.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Manual PID bypass or unhealthy service.

proof_requirements.claim: Executable tests distinguish legacy whole-second and invariant exact precision.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: legacy fractional match accepted; invariant mismatch denied

proof_requirements.claim: Foreign listener survives and malformed identity is denied.
Raw review and exact-head checks are green.
Independent signed chain passes verifier and guard.
Public and installed artifacts are exact, healthy, and clean.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Actions, release, install, owner, health, git

release_requirements.required_receipt: signed chain accepted by verifier and guard

stop_conditions: Unexpected diff, weakened exact-record comparison, foreign listener termination, dirty/multiple worktrees, failed test/review/CI, non-PASS receipt, verifier/guard rejection, or live failure.
known_discrepancies: The v0.1.10 package installed but restart failed closed because its legacy owner record stores seconds while CIM returns fractional ticks; the original v0.1.8 listener remains healthy.

requirement_trace.authority: User continuation through a working reviewed release
